shell_intro: Wellness estimates from your shared OmniGart profile
wellness_disclaimer: OmniGart provides wellness estimates only. Readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body-fat estimates, hydration targets, and training plans are not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional for health concerns.
info_sheet_not_medical_advice: Not medical advice. Consult a professional.
health_warning_chest_pain: Stop and seek emergency help if you feel chest pain, severe dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath during activity.
info_sheet_body: Figures such as readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body fat, and hydration are wellness estimates based on your inputs and device samples. Plans are coaching suggestions, not prescriptions.
calc_settings_intro: Choose how OmniGart estimates wellness figures such as energy use, heart-rate zones, body fat, and strength.

formula.bmr.mifflin_st_jeor.explain: Widely used resting energy estimate from weight, height, age, and sex.
formula.bmr.harris_benedict.title: Harris–Benedict (revised)
formula.bmr.harris_benedict.explain: Classic resting energy estimate; useful as an alternate wellness check.
formula.hr_max.tanaka.title: Tanaka

formula.body_fat.cun_bae.title: CUN-BAE
formula.body_fat.cun_bae.explain: Body-fat percentage estimate from weight, height, age, and sex.
formula.one_rm.epley.title: Epley
formula.one_rm.epley.explain: Estimates one-rep max from a submaximal lift and rep count.
formula.one_rm.brzycki.title: Brzycki

formula.hr_zones.karvonen_3.title: Karvonen (3 zones)

workout_intro: Log strength sets for wellness training estimates. Figures are coaching aids, not medical advice.
onboarding_welcome_body: A few questions so we can personalise wellness estimates on your device. You can change these later in Profile.
onboarding_sex_body: Used only to choose the male or female body-map figure and sex-specific wellness equations. Not a medical record.
onboarding_birth_body: Age is used for wellness estimates such as energy use and heart-rate zones.
onboarding_health_privacy: Health data stays on your devices. OmniGart never sells it or uses it for advertising.
perm_explainer_health_body: OmniGart can read and write wellness samples — heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, active and resting energy, heart-rate recovery, workout effort, optional mindful minutes, body mass, and hydration — so sessions can appear in Apple Fitness with duration and calories. Platform writes are append-only: OmniGart never deletes or rewrites Apple Health or Health Connect data, including its own. Data is not used for ads or sent to unrelated third parties. You can continue without granting access.
food_intro: Log meals offline. Daily totals are wellness coaching aids, not medical advice.
workouts_zone2_body: Start an easy Zone 2 continuous run for wellness aerobic work. Heart-rate bands are coaching estimates.
workouts_zone2_unavailable: Could not schedule Zone 2 right now.
workouts_zone2_flag_off: WorkoutKit scheduling is off in this build. You can still train with the in-app watch Zone 2 session when available.
recovery_intro: Wellness recovery estimates from your profile and recent inputs. Not medical advice.
recovery_empty: Complete your profile to see wellness estimates.
planner_intro: Plan workouts on-device and optionally schedule a Zone 2 run into Workout.
planner_demo_zone2_notes: Continuous easy aerobic work for wellness.
planner_schedule_body: Send a Zone 2 continuous run into the system Workout app when scheduling is enabled.
profile_intro: Edit the details from onboarding. Changes stay on this device.
workout_summary_energy_estimate: Energy is a wellness estimate (MET × body weight).
workout_watch_unavailable: Watch unavailable — use iPhone estimate below.
workout_mindful_body_intro: Prefer a live watch session for heart rate and energy. On iPhone alone, OmniGart saves a MET wellness estimate labelled as such.
workout_mindful_minutes_body: Optional. Off by default. Writes a mindful session only when you enable this.
watch.workout.summary.wellness: Wellness summary — coaching reflection, not medical advice.
data_privacy_intro: OmniGart keeps a full local copy of your workouts and samples on this device. Export stays on-device. Platform sync is optional and never required for logging.
data_privacy_export_ready: Export ready to share or save.
data_privacy_status_denied: Permission denied — local store still works
data_privacy_permission_note: OmniGart can read and write wellness workouts and samples when you allow it. You can keep logging without granting access. Platform writes are append-only: OmniGart never deletes or rewrites Apple Health or Health Connect data — including workouts it created. Local edits stay in OmniGart. If a sample is removed from the platform, OmniGart keeps your local copy.
hc_rationale_body:
OmniGart requests Health Connect access to read and write fitness and wellness data you choose — such as heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, body mass, and hydration — so readiness and training estimates stay accurate on your device.

Writes are append-only: OmniGart never deletes or rewrites Health Connect data, including workouts it created. Local edits stay in OmniGart. If a sample is removed from Health Connect, OmniGart keeps your local copy.

We do not sell health data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties for marketing. You can deny access and keep using OmniGart with manual entry.
health_restore_removed_banner: Removed from the health platform. Your OmniGart copy is still here — you can restore it.
health_restore_all_apple_health: Restore all removed to Apple Health
health_restore_all_health_connect: Restore all removed to Health Connect
health_restore_already_present: Already on the platform — local flag cleared.
health_restore_permission_needed: Health write permission is required to restore.
nutrition_target_disclaimer: Estimated daily energy — a wellness coaching aid, not medical or dietary advice.
nutrition_reason_no_weight: Add a weigh-in to see a suggested target.
nutrition_reason_rough_bmr: Height or age missing — showing a rough estimate.
nutrition_reason_baseline: Based on estimated resting energy and activity.
nutrition_reason_adaptive_ewma: Updated from your recent weigh-ins and food log.
nutrition_reason_energy_balance: Updated from your 21-day energy balance trend.
nutrition_reason_paused_insufficient: Not enough recent logs — keeping your last estimate.
nutrition_reason_logging_break: Logging break detected. Resume when you are ready — no pressure.
nutrition_reason_floor: Suggested energy was raised to stay at or above a safe floor.
nutrition_reason_auto_raise: Recent loss looked faster than planned — target nudged up.
nutrition_reason_exercise_credit: Includes a partial credit for today’s movement.
nutrition_floor_warning: This value is below the suggested minimum energy floor.
nutrition_goal_first_set: If you have a health condition, are pregnant or under 18, check with a healthcare professional.
nutrition_measurements_intro: Stored on this device. Waist-to-height is shown for awareness and is not used in the energy formula.
nutrition_low_intake_title: We’re here if you need support
nutrition_low_intake_body: Your recent logged energy looks very low. Consider Beat, NEDA, or a local helpline. You can hide calorie numbers in settings.
nutrition_add_exercise: Add a partial credit for exercise energy
